description: shipmmg provides an unofficial Python implementation of ship-manoeuvring simulation associated with the MMG modelling method. The provider is Project maintainers (see primary page). Geographical and temporal coverage: Users supply vessel and manoeuvre parameters; the repository does not establish universal validation across ship types. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The authors explicitly call this an unofficial implementation; do not attribute it as an official JASNAOE software release. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
